title: Locally finite regular CW complex with cellular G-action
body_html:
Locally finite regular CW complex with cellular $G$-action

The standing geometric setup is the following data.

  • $X$ is a locally finite regular CW complex. Regular means the attaching map from the boundary of each cell to $X$ is an embedding. Locally finite means every cell is contained in the closure of finitely many cells.
  • $G$ is a (locally profinite) group acting continuously and cellularly on $X$: $G$ permutes the set of cells and the action restricted to each cell is a homeomorphism.
  • $R$ is a coefficient ring.

The underlying topological space of $X$ is denoted $|X|$. We write $[\![X]\!]$ for the set of cells of $X$, and $[\![X]\!]_d$ for the $d$-dimensional cells. The face relation $E \preceq F$ holds when $E \subseteq \overline{F}$.

Two further standing notations:

  • $\Fix_G(S) := \{g \in G : g \cdot s = s \text{ for all } s \in S\}$ — pointwise stabilizer.
  • $\Stab_G(S) := \{g \in G : g \cdot S = S\}$ — setwise stabilizer.

For a cell $E$, $\Fix_G(E)$ and $\Stab_G(E)$ may differ; refining the CW structure can force them to agree.

Lean formalisation

The topological setup distils to a purely combinatorial poset-with-dimension abstraction. The four ingredients — poset structure, dimension, locally finite, cellular $G$-action — are separate Prop classes stacked on the same type:

Ingredient Lean class KB node
face poset + dimension AbstractCellComplex X (extends PartialOrder X) Abstract cell complex
local finiteness IsLocallyFinite X : Prop Locally finite abstract cell complex
$G$-action compatibility GCellComplex G X : Prop on top of [MulAction G X] Cellular G-action on an abstract cell complex
face-closed subsets Subcomplex X (extends SetLike) Subcomplex of an abstract cell complex
topology on the face poset Alexandrov star topology Alexandrov star topology on the face poset

The "locally finite regular CW complex with cellular $G$-action" of the paper is realised, at the abstract level, by

lean variable {G : Type*} [Group G] variable {X : Type*} variable [PartialOrder X] [AbstractCellComplex X] [IsLocallyFinite X] variable [MulAction G X] [GCellComplex G X]

Every downstream Lean definition — cosheaves, chain complex, equivariant functors, induction, QFD — is stated against exactly this typeclass stack. Regularity of the CW complex is not tracked as a Prop mixin at the abstract level; it re-enters only in the geometric-realisation direction, where it identifies $\Fix_G$ (pointwise) with $\Stab_G$ (setwise) on individual cells.

The pointwise-vs-setwise distinction on the paper side collapses to MulAction.stabilizer G E : Subgroup G at the poset level (a single object, since setwise = pointwise on the discrete cell set) — see the design remark in Cellular G-action on an abstract cell complex.
